name: origamix
description: A low-code agent platform and visual builder
author: yupeilin <yuchacha250@gmail.com>

scripts.lint: pnpm release:version --check && eslint scripts && pnpm -r lint
scripts.gate:internal: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @origamix/server build && pnpm --filter @origamix/server gate:agent
scripts.package:dir: pnpm release:registry && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @origamix/desktop package:dir
scripts.package:mac: pnpm release:registry && pnpm check && pnpm --filter @origamix/desktop package:mac
scripts.test:template: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @origamix/server build && pnpm --filter @origamix/server test:template
scripts.test:web: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @origamix/server build && pnpm --filter @origamix/app test:web
scripts.release:check: pnpm release:version --check && pnpm pack:npm && tsx scripts/check-public-packages.ts
scripts.build:prepared: pnpm --filter @origamix/server build && pnpm --filter @origamix/app build && pnpm --filter @origamix/desktop build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build:libs && pnpm typecheck:prepared && pnpm test:prepared && pnpm build:prepared
